## Accepted restricted results, attempt 1/5

AIM Computational Algebraic Statistics Problem 28; corpus 20001204 / AIM-COMPUTATION-0042, rank 1275. The original problem appears in Seth Sullivant’s section. The full authored report proves Theorems A/B/C: the quadratic Graver classification, the quartic classification for complexes with a facet containing all but one actual vertex, and the quartic threshold for complexes with at most three facets. The exact transportation subfamily degree is 2^(1+min(b,c)) under its stated positive-overlap hypotheses.

The complete proof retains every analytic circuit table, ordered cell list and elimination equation; empty-ground-set, ghost and saturated cases; the exact Lawrence identity and indispensable two-point fibers; both bounds for simplex attachment; cone reduction and valid grouped-state fiber restrictions; and the exact transportation-cycle degree argument. The accompanying mathematical audit and acceptance report accept exactly these restricted conclusions.

The unrestricted AIM classification remains unresolved by this work. No global novelty or priority is claimed. Known mechanisms are credited explicitly to Bernstein–O’Neill, Bernstein–Sullivant, Engström–Kahle–Sullivant and the classical Lawrence theorem discussed by Petrović–Stokes. The graphical classification of Král’–Norine–Pangrác is already known. These restricted results may be direct consequences or short syntheses of established literature.

## Distribution and review limits

Exactly seven authored proof/audit/acceptance/status and public-source-metadata files are added under `unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/20001204/`. All mathematical statements, analytic proofs, examples and qualifications are retained. Editorial changes remove unavailable-checker references, supplementary enumeration/determinant outputs and private revision identities, and bind the audit and acceptance to the distributed files. Excluded computational outputs are not recast as prose. The complete authored analytic certificate tables and equations remain included.

Programs, computational outputs and receipts, JSON fixtures, datasets, copied third-party sources or extracted source text/images, and private coordination material are excluded. This AI-assisted, unrefereed edition claims no external human peer review, journal acceptance, formal proof-assistant certification, historical novelty or exhaustive current-openness. Source metadata records historical retrieval and inspection observations; edition preparation claims no fresh scholarly retrieval, source-file rehash, source inspection or literature search.

QUEUE.md and unrelated content remain unchanged. Editorial preparation adds no substantive proof turn and does not reset partial attempt 1/5. No merge, release, DOI or outside outreach is requested.

Base commit: `f6caddda8f8be2cdb3e91494325d8f7f365bc3fc`.
